card.name: Words announcing a historic turning point
card.fires_on: Words just before a noun like step, milestone or turning point, where a text calls an event significant, e.g. "marked", "landmark", "major", "huge". Seen in news and history text about achievements.

modes.label: Marked a turning point
modes.description: The verb "marked" after an event or date, leading into a significance phrase.
modes.example: Enactment of the Pollution Prevention Act of 1990<< marked>> a turning point in the direction of U

modes.label: Big-achievement adjectives
modes.description: Adjectives like major, huge or landmark after "a" that describe an event as a step or victory.
modes.example: “We’re still far away from building a practical quantum computer, but this is a<< major>> step forward.”

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like milestone, landmark, pivotal and their Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires when text is about to call an event a milestone or turning point.
